reviewer: Tharun BL (Agricultural Research, Voice & Dataset Governance Lead)

changes.title: Conditional Drone ULV Calibration & Safety Buffer Rule
changes.old_behavior: Only high-volume knapsack water volume (500 L/ha) was supported; drone queries triggered generic clarification
changes.new_behavior: Structured drone ULV calibration encoded: 20-25 L/ha spray volume for CIBRC-registered molecules, VMD 100-150 µm droplet size, wind speed <10 km/h, and 100m buffer zone
changes.reason: Enforces strict CIBRC Drone SOP compliance and prevents dangerous chemical drift or phytotoxicity
changes.source_evidence: CIBRC SOP for Drone Application of Pesticides (Govt of India, 2022/2024); TNAU Drone Advisory (2024)

changes.title: Rice False Smut (Ustilaginoidea virens) Knowledge & Boot-Leaf Preventive Rule
changes.old_behavior: False smut queries triggered safe officer escalation as out-of-corpus disease
changes.new_behavior: Full RAG corpus integration with strict boot-leaf stage preventive timing (Copper Hydroxide @ 1.25 kg/ha or Propiconazole @ 500 ml/ha) and explicit ban on flowering-stage sprays
changes.reason: Resolves high-frequency farmer queries during humid Late Samba flowering seasons in Delta tracts
changes.source_evidence: ICAR-IIRR Rice Diseases Compendium (2023); TNAU Crop Production Guide (2020/2024)

changes.title: Rice Stem Rot (Sclerotium oryzae) Agronomic & Water Drainage Protocol
changes.old_behavior: Stem rot queries triggered clarifying questions on generic sheath symptoms
changes.new_behavior: Dedicated disease document DOC-DIS-006 with primary cultural recommendation (field drainage/aeration), muriate of potash application, and waterline-directed sprays (Hexaconazole, Validamycin)
changes.reason: Provides authoritative guidance for ill-drained lowland paddy lodging disorders
changes.source_evidence: TNAU Agritech Crop Protection Rice Stem Rot (2023); IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank (2022)

changes.title: Southern Tamil Nadu Gall Midge Alias Promotion (வெங்காயத்தாள் புழு)
changes.new_behavior: Promoted to VERIFIED with direct canonical entity mapping to Gall midge (Orseolia oryzae)
changes.reason: AC&RI Madurai extension surveys confirmed universal usage across Tirunelveli, Madurai, and Tenkasi with zero cross-pest ambiguity
changes.source_evidence: AC&RI Madurai & KVK Ambasamudram Regional Farmer Survey 2025-2026

changes.title: Multi-Turn Diagnostic Tree for Zinc Deficiency vs Brown Spot
changes.old_behavior: Ambiguous foliar brown spot queries relied solely on single-turn similarity retrieval
changes.new_behavior: Structured decision tree evaluates crop stage (2-4 WAT vs later), soil/water context (alkaline/ill-drained vs sandy), lesion morphology (midrib bronze vs oval spots with halo), and field pattern before prescribing 0.5% ZnSO4 or Mancozeb
changes.reason: Prevents misdiagnosis and unnecessary chemical fungicide sprays on nutritional chlorosis
changes.source_evidence: TNAU Soil Science Micronutrient Advisory (2023); IRRI Diagnostic Decision Tree (2022)

changes.title: Bio-Control (Pseudomonas fluorescens) 7-Day Chemical Separation Gate
changes.old_behavior: Biological inoculant dosage lacked explicit chemical fungicide tank-mix incompatibility checks
changes.new_behavior: Hard safety gate enforces mandatory 7-day separation interval between Pseudomonas application and chemical fungicide sprays
changes.reason: Prevents destruction of living antagonistic bacterial colonies by synthetic copper/triazole fungicides
changes.source_evidence: TNAU Department of Plant Pathology Bio-inoculant Manual (2023); ICAR-NBAIR (2022)

changes.title: Institutional Open Educational Attribution Documentation (CC-BY-NC 4.0)
changes.new_behavior: Updated with formal institutional attribution metadata under TNAU / ICAR public extension repository terms
changes.reason: Ensures complete intellectual property compliance and data provenance governance
changes.source_evidence: TNAU Directorate of Extension Education Public Domain Guidelines (2024)
